goals.title: Tootheus CAD Finalization
goals.description: Onshape CAD of Tootheus including structures, fluids, recovery, and avionics. Must include a list of all parts required to allow for building to commence.

goals.title: Fluids System Design Review
goals.description: Reviewing all FAR requirements and making sure that P&ID and CAD reflects them.

goals.title: Aerostructures Design Review
goals.description: All structures decisions have been made and a list of parts is created. CAD is completed and Drawings have been made for manufacturing.

goals.title: Tootheus Launch Attempt
goals.description: A launch attempt of the Tootheus Launch Vehicle

goals.title: Tootheus System Testing
goals.description: Waterflow tests, Instrumentation tests, Click Tests, Cold Flow, and Static Fire have been completed.

goals.title: Recovery Design Review
goals.description: Full analysis and recovery strategy has been considered and written in a short report. CAD has been implemented into aerostructures.

goals.title: Avionics Design Review
goals.description: Avionics upgrades / system has been designed and implemented into CAD, short report has been written.

goals.title: Tootheus Launch Readiness Review
goals.description: Meeting with experts and slide presentations covering the full design of the rocket

goals.title: Liquid Space Shot Launch
goals.description: Successful launch of the world's first liquid space shot launched from a collegiate rocketry team.

goals.title: DONKEY Booster Launch Vehicle
goals.description: This is the first stage of the space shot, which will be launched and tested in 2028.
